moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest music festivals, Reading and Leeds, take place this August Bank Holiday weekend (August 27-30, 2026), featuring headliners Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds are ON! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park this weekend to catch the biggest names in music? #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Fontaines D.C., and Chase & Status to Florence + The Machine, the Reading & Leeds lineup is stacked. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Local Buzz (Leeds)
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is taking over Bramham Park! Are you ready for a weekend of epic music and Bank Holiday vibes right here in Yorkshire? #LeedsFestival

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday weekend in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland runs from Saturday, August 29 to Monday, August 31, 2026, marking the unofficial end of summer holidays for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Long weekend incoming! What are your big plans for the August Bank Holiday? Making the most of the last blast of summer?

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: If you're travelling this Bank Holiday weekend, expect busy roads and check public transport for changes. Plan ahead and stay safe!

angles.name: Local Bank Holiday (Wales)
angles.copy: Dydd Llun Gŵyl y Banc hapus! How are you spending your August Bank Holiday here in Wales? Fingers crossed for sunshine!

moments.title: End of Meteorological Summer
moments.blurb: Monday, August 31, 2026, marks the official end of meteorological summer, with autumn officially beginning on September 1st.

angles.name: Summer Wrap Up
angles.copy: It's the last day of meteorological summer today! What was your favourite summer memory of 2026?

angles.name: Autumn Awaits
angles.copy: Summer bows out today, and tomorrow we officially welcome autumn. Are you ready for cosy nights and pumpkin spice everything?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains the UK's Official Singles Chart Number 1, making history with its long run, while HUGEL's 'Movin' To The Sun' is a strong contender for next week's top spot.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are still holding strong at UK Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'! An incredible run for the longest-running chart-topper.

angles.name: New Challenger
angles.copy: Could we see a new Number 1 next week? HUGEL's 'Movin' To The Sun' is making a big push for the top spot on the Official Singles Chart!

moments.title: Happy 60th Birthday, Shirley Manson!
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish lead vocalist of alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today, August 26, 2026.

angles.name: Garbage Icon
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson! The voice of Garbage and a true alternative rock legend. What's your favourite Garbage track?

angles.name: 90s Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Celebrating Shirley Manson's 60th today! From 'Only Happy When It Rains' to 'Stupid Girl,' her impact on 90s rock is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Shania Twain!
moments.blurb: Canadian country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known as the 'Queen of Country Pop,' turns 61 on August 28, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain on Friday! Let's get 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' on repeat.

angles.name: Still The One
angles.copy: Celebrating Shania Twain's birthday this week! What's your all-time favourite hit from the country-pop legend? 'You're Still The One' is up there for us!

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday, Florence Welch!
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the lead vocalist and songwriter of the acclaimed indie rock band Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28, 2026.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch on Friday! From 'Lungs' to 'Dance Fever,' her powerful voice continues to captivate.

angles.name: Festival Queen
angles.copy: Florence Welch is 40 this week! Catch her distinctive sound headlining Reading & Leeds, just in time for her birthday celebrations.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Bebe Rexha!
moments.blurb: American singer and songwriter Bebe Rexha, known for hits like 'I'm Good (Blue)' and 'Meant to Be', turns 37 on August 30, 2026.

angles.name: Pop Hitmaker
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 37th Birthday to Bebe Rexha on Sunday! What's your favourite track from the pop hitmaker?

angles.name: Dance Floor Filler
angles.copy: Get ready to dance for Bebe Rexha's birthday this weekend! Her collaborations always bring the party.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Debbie Gibson!
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson, who became the youngest artist to write, produce, and perform a Billboard Hot 100 number-one single, turns 56 on August 31, 2026.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the incredible Debbie Gibson on Monday! Still remember 'Foolish Beat' and 'Lost in Your Eyes'?

angles.name: Teenage Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Debbie Gibson's birthday this Bank Holiday! She made history as a teen, writing and producing her own #1 hits. A true talent!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Gloria Estefan!
moments.blurb: Cuban-American singer and 'Queen of Latin Pop' Gloria Estefan, known for her work with Miami Sound Machine and solo hits, turns 69 on September 1, 2026.

angles.name: Latin Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 69th Birthday to the legendary Gloria Estefan on Tuesday! Get ready to 'Conga!'

angles.name: Miami Sound
angles.copy: Celebrating Gloria Estefan's birthday this week! Her incredible career with Miami Sound Machine and as a solo artist has given us so many timeless hits.

moments.title: Happy 80th Birthday, Barry Gibb!
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the legendary singer, songwriter, and producer, best known as a co-founder of the Bee Gees, turns 80 on September 1, 2026.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the iconic Barry Gibb on Tuesday! The unmistakable voice behind so many Bee Gees classics. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: Celebrating 80 years of Barry Gibb! From 'Stayin' Alive' to 'How Deep Is Your Love,' his songwriting and falsetto defined eras. #BeeGees
